items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Then later he and his wife opened their own club, and we sort of lost touch.

ctx.x: He was a drummer of Hawaiian and Portuguese extraction, and he had a band, and he used to play all the officers' clubs -- and he did quite well. Then later he and his wife opened their own club, and we sort of lost touch.
You said also that while you were in Honolulu, playing with the Symphony, you had a Jazz sextet, the Red Callender Sextet...
